name: residential_radius_effect
description: REH 4.6 through the grading of one K-6 school (capacity 500 -> units 1, radius 150 m, lot centre (32, 32), distance curve 0xE921A936 = (0,100) (1,0)) on 64 m tracts with residents only at (0, 0) (100) and (0, 2) (50). GetPopulationServed reads the distance in tracts over r' in metres [quirk]: (0, 2) is at xd = 2 / 150 x 100 = 1.33 -> 0 %, so served = 100 and grade 1.0. The EQ boost (value 1.0, radius r' x slop = 165) reads the same curve at the 0..1 fraction xd = 1 - (r - d) / r: (0, 0) gets 1.0; (0, 1) has no residents and is skipped without advancing the z centre [quirk], so (0, 2) is measured from (0, 1)'s centre: d = 64, xd = 64 / 165 -> 61.2 % -> EQ 0.6121212 (from its own centre, d = 128, it would get 0.2242). Tracts without residents get nothing.
